title: Multi Server Delete
description: Select multiple servers with checkboxes and delete them all at once
body:
# Multi Server Delete 
- adds checkboxes to your server list so you can select and delete multiple servers at once

> No more clicking Delete → confirm → Delete → confirm for every single server. Just check the ones you want gone and hit Delete once
> 
> How it works?
Small checkboxes appear next to each server icon
Click a checkbox to select that server
Hit Delete - all selected servers are removed instantly, no confirmation screen
If nothing is checked, Delete works exactly like vanilla
